name: Lucena

queries.query: Lucena City Philippines official cadastral parcel map GIS lot map assessor
queries.result: Found the official Quezon Provincial Assessor page. It identifies tax mapping, cadastral-map scanning, tax-map custody, property-index numbering, and verification/issuance of tax maps; it is a registry/custodian lead, not an open parcel geometry service. The official Lucena city site was also found, but no public parcel viewer or API was exposed in the fetched page.

queries.query: Lucena City mapa ng lupa cadastral GIS assessor
queries.result: Search results did not expose a Lucena-specific public parcel viewer or downloadable parcel geometry. The official Quezon Assessor page remains the relevant local custodial lead; Geoportal Philippines exposes a public map/lot-plotter application, but no Lucena parcel layer or bounded parcel response was identified.

freshResearch.searchMethod: bounded web discovery plus ordinary HTTPS GET inspection; no login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or private fields used

registryBasis: The official Quezon Provincial Assessor page places the office in Capitol Compound, Brgy. 10, Lucena City and documents the Tax Mapping Operations Division as custodian of cadastral maps, tax maps and index maps, including scanning cadastral maps and verification/issuance of tax maps. This establishes a relevant official cadastral/tax-map custodian, but not an open geometry endpoint.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: Provincial assessment and tax-mapping custody; page specifically lists Lucena City contact/location context.
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Documents preparation and custody of cadastral maps, tax maps, index maps and tax-mapping control rolls; also scanning cadastral maps and verification/issuance of tax maps. No machine-readable public parcel layer is linked on the inspected page.
Public landing page provides city governance/contact navigation but did not expose a parcel viewer, cadastral download, or map API in the fetched HTML.

officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: National geospatial portal and map applications.

blocker: No anonymous, Lucena-scoped parcel polygon response with a stable native identity was verified. The official assessor evidence supports registry custody and map production, not public API integration.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point is a research locator and was not shifted. A local or national service may exist behind an unlinked, restricted, or separately requested dataset; absence from these bounded public checks is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
nextStep: A future attempt should obtain or discover a documented public Lucena parcel service, inspect its current viewer configuration if present, and request only a small geometry-plus-safe-ID response near the saved WUP point.
